title: Study on the mechanism of Phoslock's impact on nitrogen migration at the sediment–water interface
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00062A, Paper
Penglong Wang, Jiehua Wang, Songwei Zhang, Jinyue Fan, Xiuling Bai, Pingping Zhang, Zhiqiang Jiao, Bing Zhao, Xiubo Ren
Phoslock slowed down NO3−–N consumption and increased NH4+–N concentration in the overlying water. It accelerated the migration of bioavailable NO3−–N from overlying water to sediment and slowed down the release of bioavailable NH4+–N from sediment.
